neighbours.label: a connective that opens a reason clause (since, as, puisque, ya que); the − pole is the concessive side (but, except, though)
fire: We stayed indoors, since the roads were covered in ice.
The match was cancelled, as the pitch was flooded.
Il n'a pas répondu, puisqu'il dormait déjà.
No fuimos a la playa, ya que llovía toda la tarde.
She took the bus, since her bike had a flat tyre.
The shop closed early, as most staff were ill.
Nous sommes rentrés tôt, puisque le musée fermait à cinq heures.
El vuelo se retrasó, ya que había niebla en Madrid.
quiet: We stayed indoors, although the roads were mostly clear.
The match went ahead, but the pitch was flooded.
Il n'a pas répondu, bien qu'il fût réveillé.
Fuimos a la playa, aunque llovía toda la tarde.
She took the bus, even though her bike was fine.
The shop stayed open, though most staff were ill.
Nous sommes rentrés tard, mais le musée fermait à cinq heures.
El vuelo salió a tiempo, aunque había niebla en Madrid.

notes: Card + peaks: puisque, ya que, having, as; − peaks: except, but, yet, though, хотя. Probe: 'since' 0.37, 'puisque' 0.41, 'although' 0.06.
